description: Fleet log line format (docs/specs/fleet-logging.md). Each case gives the structured event and the exact line both cortexkit-log (Rust) and @cortexkit/log (TS) must render. Timestamps are fixed inputs; a renderer that reads the clock cannot pass this fixture and must accept an injected instant.

cases.name: plain-info-no-session
cases.line: 2026-09-05T10:41:03.123Z INFO  fusiform poll changed version=1788526509641 eras=22 facts_changed=0 arrived=2

cases.name: session-and-tag
cases.line: 2026-09-05T10:41:03.130Z WARN  magic-context session=opencode:ses_00fc88222ffe tag=perf transform stage folded ms=412 retry=2

cases.name: error-level-padding
cases.line: 2026-09-05T10:41:04.002Z ERROR insula refresh failed provider=codex account=ufuk3 class=auth_invalid

cases.name: debug-and-trace-padding
cases.line: 2026-09-05T10:41:05.000Z DEBUG broca session=broca:8f3a1c02 dispatch admitted run=r_12 model=anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5

cases.name: trace-level
cases.line: 2026-09-05T10:41:05.001Z TRACE callosum tag=wire frame channel=716 bytes=1024

cases.name: value-with-space-is-quoted
cases.line: 2026-09-05T10:41:06.000Z INFO  aft session=opencode:ses_f8f153e60ffe slow tool_call name=aft_search root="/Users/x/My Project" ms=1602

cases.name: value-with-quote-and-newline-is-escaped
cases.line: 2026-09-05T10:41:07.000Z WARN  plexus vendor error body="line one\nsaid \"no\""

cases.name: message-newline-is-escaped
cases.line: 2026-09-05T10:41:08.000Z ERROR synapse engine crashed\nlast stderr: boom

cases.name: two-session-fields
cases.line: 2026-09-05T10:41:09.000Z INFO  prefrontal-core session=opencode:ses_abc run started broca_session=broca:8f3a1c02 agent=ag_9

cases.name: backslash-in-message-and-value
cases.line: 2026-09-05T10:41:11.000Z INFO  aft path C:\\Users\\x root="C:\\Users\\x\\My Project" bare=C:\x
cases.note: message and quoted values escape backslash; an unquoted value is verbatim because only the quoted form has an escape grammar

level_filter.description: CK_LOG grammar cases: spec -> whether an event at (level, tag) is emitted.

cases.note: empty spec is the default: info
malformed spec falls back to info and reports once
